purpose: Seed of already-understood CLR/runtime symbols. The discovery atlas treats everything else in Assembly-CSharp as unclassified until evidence promotes it.

knownFacts.fact: HeroShowSetting.Update builds GameObject name Camp_<level>, calls GameObject.Find, then finds or creates child GrabCamera.
HeroShowSetting.Setting configures SH shader globals and URP shadowDistance; it does not itself load the Camp scene.

negativeKnowledge.result: No strong serialized Camp_<level>/HeroShowSetting field fingerprint. Do not repeat this global bundle scan for the same hypothesis.
HeroShowBlend is globally shared and has too many dependents to identify Formation by material dependency alone.

rule: Unknown does not mean irrelevant. Preserve unknown symbols with stable CLR RIDs, graph neighborhood, strings, resource/scene/render tags, and evidence so later discoveries can resolve them without rescanning.
